subtitle: 一句话，现场造一张卡
description: 输入一句话，应用在本机识别出时间/地点/类型，现场长出一张按场景各不相同的卡，并把确认过的卡与偏好写进本机长期记忆（memory.json，与生成器同一套 schema）。不依赖任何服务也完整可用。
release_notes: 0.6.0 - reads the assistant's own conversation memory (octos.session.history) and folds it into the long-term memory it already keeps, behind a default-off switch; 0.5.0 added one-shot model calls (model.complete) with memory attached; 0.4.0 added the long-term memory.
